summary: Step-by-step contextual guide anchored to interface elements.
whenToUse: Introducing key features in an optional guide.
whenNotToUse: For a multi-step form use FormWizard.
Do not replace essential labels or documentation with a guide.

props.name: steps
props.description: Steps with id, title, content and a target selector or function.

keyboard.action: Navigates, advances or closes the guide.

accessibility: Non-modal popover with managed name and focus; the guide can be skipped.
A missing target is announced and does not block navigation.
responsive: The popover repositions within the viewport; the target is scrolled into view.
commonMistakes: Make sure the target is visible and that selectors are unique.
Handle completion and persistence of the guide in the consumer; to restart, reset the current step.
limits: Does not save state and does not navigate between pages automatically.
